metadata.question: Was there more smoke on January 1, 2020 in the coastal regions of Victoria and New South Wales, Australia compared to July 24, 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Need to compare smoke levels between two dates - January 1, 2020 and July 24, 2019 in coastal regions of Victoria and New South Wales, Australia. 2. Data: MODIS or VIIRS for smoke detection. MODIS Collection 6.1 (MCD19A2) has Aerosol Optical Depth, or I can use the MODIS Active Fires product. Better to use aerosol/smoke specific bands. 3. Location: Coastal regions of Victoria and NSW - need to define a polygon covering these coastal areas. 4. Dates: Two specific dates to compare. 5. Processing: Calculate average aerosol/smoke values for each date and compare. 6. Potential issues: Cloud contamination, no data availability. For smoke detection, I'll use MODIS Aerosol Optical Depth (AOD) from MODIS Terra/Aqua combined product (MCD19A2) which has AOD at 550nm. Higher AOD typically indicates more smoke/dust. Let me structure: - Define coastal polygon for Victoria and NSW - Get MODIS AOD data for both dates - Check if collections have data - Calculate mean AOD for each date - Compare values ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define coastal region of Victoria and New South Wales const coastalRegion = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [140.0, -39.0], [155.0, -39.0], [155.0, -33.0], [140.0, -33.0], [140.0, -39.0] ]); // 2. Define dates for comparison const date1 = '2019-07-24'; const date2 = '2020-01-01'; // 3. Get MODIS Aerosol Optical Depth data (smoke indicator) const getAODData = function(date) { const startDate = ee.Date(date); const endDate = startDate.advance(1, 'day'); return ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD19A2_GRANULES') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(coastalRegion) .select('Optical_Depth_055'); }; // 4. Get data for both dates const col1 = getAODData(date1); const col2 = getAODData(date2); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`${date1} Images: ${size1}`); console.log(`${date2} Images: ${size2}`); // Check for empty collections if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 5. Process images - use mean composite for each date const img1 = col1.mean().multiply(0.001); // Scale factor const img2 = col2.mean().multiply(0.001); // Scale factor // 6. Calculate mean AOD values const reducer = ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }); const stats1 = img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: coastalRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2 = img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: coastalRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const mean1 = stats1.get('Optical_Depth_055_mean').getInfo(); const count1 = stats1.get('Optical_Depth_055_count').getInfo(); const mean2 = stats2.get('Optical_Depth_055_mean').getInfo(); const count2 = stats2.get('Optical_Depth_055_count').getInfo(); console.log(`${date1} Mean AOD: ${mean1?.toFixed(4)}, Pixels: ${count1}`); console.log(`${date2} Mean AOD: ${mean2?.toFixed(4)}, Pixels: ${count2}`); // Check for no valid pixels if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failure if (mean1 === null || mean2 === null || isNaN(mean1) || isNaN(mean2)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // 7. Compare smoke levels (AOD values) const moreSmokeOnJan2020 = mean2 > mean1; console.log(`AOD Difference: ${(mean2 - mean1).toFixed(4)}`); if (moreSmokeOnJan2020) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
